name: William H. Burton Jr.
biography: William H. Burton, Jr. is an actor, stunt coordinator and stuntman. He is the son of talented stunt coordinator and stuntman William H. Burton. He started his career in Hollywood as an actor. During the 1970s, he appeared in TV shows like The Immortal and The Quest, as well as films like Earthquake and Slumber Party '57. However, in 1987, Burton transitioned to a career as a stunt performer. Burton is a distinguished stunt performer and a member of Stunts Unlimited. As a stunt performer, Burton has worked on films like Predators 2, Patriot Games, Godzilla, xXx, and The 40-Year Old Virgin. He has participated in more than 180 shoots.
